sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "locations" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "sync_state" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'localOnly', "type" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "parent_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES locations (id), "archived_at" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "lots" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "sync_state" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'localOnly', "code" TEXT NOT NULL, "supplier_id" TEXT NULL, "supplier_name" TEXT NULL, "grain_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "declared_quantity" REAL NOT NULL, "quantity_unit" TEXT NOT NULL, "received_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "screening_status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending', "archived_at" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "harvests" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "sync_state" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'localOnly', "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "grain_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "harvested_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "notes" TEXT NULL, "archived_at" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "items" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "sync_state" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'localOnly', "owner_role" TEXT NOT NULL, "label" TEXT NOT NULL, "grain_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "quantity" REAL NOT NULL, "quantity_unit" TEXT NOT NULL, "storage_date" TEXT NOT NULL, "location_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES locations (id), "lot_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES lots (id), "harvest_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES harvests (id), "archived_at" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "scans" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "sync_state" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'localOnly', "item_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES items (id), "captured_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "duration_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, "sample_rate" INTEGER NOT NULL, "quality" TEXT NOT NULL, "quality_reasons" TEXT NOT NULL, "model_version" TEXT NOT NULL, "result" TEXT NOT NULL, "confidence" REAL NULL, "experimental" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("experimental" IN (0, 1)), "latency_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, "device_model" TEXT NOT NULL, "os_version" TEXT NOT NULL, "audio_retained" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("audio_retained" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TRIGGER scans_append_only BEFORE UPDATE OF id, item_id, captured_at, duration_ms, sample_rate, quality, quality_reasons, model_version, result, confidence, experimental, latency_ms, device_model, os_version, audio_retained, created_at ON scans BEGIN SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'scans are append-only');END

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "inspections" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "sync_state" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'localOnly', "item_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES items (id), "scan_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES scans (id), "inspected_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "inspector" TEXT NOT NULL, "observations" TEXT NOT NULL, "verified_finding" TEXT NOT NULL, "follow_up_status" TEXT NOT NULL, "assigned_to" TEXT NULL, "photo_paths" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TRIGGER inspections_verified_immutable BEFORE UPDATE OF id, item_id, scan_id, inspected_at, inspector, observations, verified_finding, photo_paths, created_at ON inspections BEGIN SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'verified inspection fields are immutable');END

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "labeled_samples" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "sync_state" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'localOnly', "scan_id" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES scans (id), "item_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES items (id), "label" TEXT NOT NULL, "inspection_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES inspections (id), "grain_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "sack_material" TEXT NULL, "environment" TEXT NULL, "notes" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TRIGGER labeled_samples_immutable BEFORE UPDATE OF id, scan_id, item_id, label, inspection_id, grain_type, sack_material, environment, notes, created_at ON labeled_samples BEGIN SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'labeled samples are immutable');END

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sightings" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "sync_state" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'localOnly', "role" TEXT NOT NULL, "source" TEXT NOT NULL, "observed_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "location_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES locations (id), "item_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES items (id), "latitude" REAL NULL, "longitude" REAL NULL, "accuracy_meters" REAL NULL, "distance" TEXT NULL, "analysis" TEXT NULL, "sound" TEXT NULL, "user_validated" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("user_validated" IN (0, 1)), "user_card_id" TEXT NULL, "verified_finding" TEXT NULL, "notes" TEXT NULL, "media_path" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TRIGGER sightings_analysis_immutable BEFORE UPDATE OF id, role, source, observed_at, latitude, longitude, accuracy_meters, distance, analysis, sound, created_at ON sightings BEGIN SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'sighting AI analysis is immutable');END
CREATE TRIGGER sightings_verified_once BEFORE UPDATE OF verified_finding ON sightings WHEN OLD.verified_finding IS NOT NULL BEGIN SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'verified sighting finding is immutable');END

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sensor_nodes" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "sync_state" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'localOnly', "device_address" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "type" TEXT NOT NULL, "protocol_version" INTEGER NOT NULL, "firmware_version" TEXT NOT NULL, "key_fingerprint" TEXT NOT NULL, "location_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES locations (id), "item_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES items (id), "last_seen_at" TEXT NULL, "battery_percent" INTEGER NULL, "events_cleared_through_seq" INTEGER NULL, "health_cleared_through_at" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sensor_events" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "sync_state" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'localOnly', "node_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES sensor_nodes (id), "seq" INTEGER NOT NULL, "started_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "duration_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, "event_class" TEXT NOT NULL, "peak_hz" REAL NOT NULL, "min_hz" REAL NOT NULL, "max_hz" REAL NOT NULL, "slope_hz_per_ms" REAL NOT NULL, "snr_db" REAL NOT NULL, "peak_dbfs" REAL NOT NULL, "impulses" INTEGER NOT NULL, "rep_rate_hz" REAL NOT NULL, "harmonics" INTEGER NOT NULL, "signature_id" TEXT NULL, "pack_version" TEXT NULL, "match_score" REAL NULL, "match_experimental" INTEGER NULL CHECK ("match_experimental" IN (0, 1)), "location_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES locations (id), "item_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES items (id), PRIMARY KEY ("id"), UNIQUE ("node_id", "seq"));

CREATE TRIGGER sensor_events_append_only BEFORE UPDATE OF id, node_id, seq, started_at, duration_ms, event_class, peak_hz, min_hz, max_hz, slope_hz_per_ms, snr_db, peak_dbfs, impulses, rep_rate_hz, harmonics, signature_id, pack_version, match_score, match_experimental, location_id, item_id, created_at ON sensor_events BEGIN SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'sensor events are append-only');END

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "reminders" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "sync_state" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'localOnly', "item_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES items (id), "due_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL, "notification_id" INTEGER NOT NULL UNIQUE, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "settings" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "sync_state" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'localOnly', "key" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "value" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sensor_health_changes" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "sync_state" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'localOnly', "node_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES sensor_nodes (id), "at" TEXT NOT NULL, "health" TEXT NOT NULL, "seq" INTEGER NULL, "location_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES locations (id), "item_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES items (id), PRIMARY KEY ("id"), UNIQUE ("node_id", "at", "health"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "knowledge_cards" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "sync_state" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'localOnly', "card_id" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "names" TEXT NOT NULL, "pest_group" TEXT NOT NULL, "safety" TEXT NOT NULL, "summary" TEXT NOT NULL, "signs" TEXT NOT NULL, "look_alikes" TEXT NOT NULL, "health_risks" TEXT NOT NULL, "safe_steps" TEXT NOT NULL, "call_professional_when" TEXT NOT NULL, "first_aid" TEXT NOT NULL, "legal" TEXT NULL, "sources" TEXT NOT NULL, "review_status" TEXT NOT NULL, "pack_version" TEXT NOT NULL, "content_hash" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "card_embeddings" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "sync_state" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'localOnly', "card_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES knowledge_cards (card_id), "model_version" TEXT NOT NULL, "dim" INTEGER NOT NULL, "vector" BLOB NOT NULL, "content_hash" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), UNIQUE ("card_id", "model_version", "dim"));
CREATE INDEX items_owner_role ON items (owner_role)
CREATE INDEX items_location ON items (location_id)
CREATE INDEX items_lot ON items (lot_id)
CREATE INDEX items_harvest ON items (harvest_id)
CREATE INDEX scans_item_captured ON scans (item_id, captured_at)
CREATE INDEX inspections_item ON inspections (item_id)
CREATE INDEX reminders_item ON reminders (item_id)
CREATE INDEX labeled_samples_item ON labeled_samples (item_id)
CREATE INDEX sightings_observed ON sightings (observed_at)
CREATE INDEX sightings_location ON sightings (location_id)
CREATE INDEX sightings_item ON sightings (item_id)
CREATE INDEX sensor_events_started ON sensor_events (started_at)
CREATE INDEX sensor_events_location ON sensor_events (location_id)
CREATE INDEX sensor_events_item ON sensor_events (item_id)
CREATE INDEX sensor_health_node_at ON sensor_health_changes (node_id, at)
